title: asterix dissector updated (new feature, refactor)
description: New feature (now possible to select uap in categories with multiple uaps), refactor (preferences labels, empty functions in generated code omitted).

notes.body: Looks like you need to rebase localy.
Rebased to master, please check if ok.

There are some spelling errors/typos from the pipeline:

epan/dissectors/packet-asterix-generated.h 6389 / 11683 "DC : Differencial Correction" Differencial ->  ?

epan/dissectors/packet-asterix-generated.h 9377 / 11683 "VAL : PO Transpomder Capability" Transpomder ->  ?

tools/asterix/generate_dissector.py 3933 / 5424 "generate_expanstion_entry(cat," expanstion ->  ?

tools/asterix/generate_dissector.py 4719 / 5424 "generate_expanstion_entry(cat," expanstion ->  ?

Typos in generate_dissectors.py corrected.

For generated file, asterix-specs must be updated (@zoranbosnjak can you check?).
